hash.encoding: RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 JSON restricted to the source validator's accepted values
hash.envelope: { kind, hashVersion: 'revision-hash-v1', ...envelope }; envelope cannot override kind or hashVersion
hash.resultingHash: Excluded from its own input; callers remove kind/hash from stored records before rehashing.
hash.schemaVersion: contract-v1 identifies this source schema snapshot; no extra schemaVersion field is added to the wire envelope.
hash.integers: Safe integers; untyped floats, unsafe integers and lone surrogates are rejected.
hash.chains: Sequence starts at 1 with previousHash null; ordered sequences, predecessor hashes, expected kinds and repeated-digest denial are defined by validateChain.
hash.unhashed: Mutable heads, assignment/resolution/account projections, review applicability, tombstone/purge projections, idempotency indexes and delivery infrastructure are not extra record kinds.

anchors.textOffsets: Unicode code points; end exclusive; no implicit Unicode/newline normalization

quantizer.rounding: Exact rational arithmetic, ties toward positive infinity; negative zero becomes zero.
quantizer.box: Quantize endpoints, derive width/height by subtraction; reject collapse.
quantizer.circle: Center normalized by width/height, radius by min(width,height); full-disk containment before and after quantization.
quantizer.frame: Positive safe-integer intrinsic pixel dimensions and digest; optional versioned crop with integer origins.

provenance.registration: Principal and integer UTC epoch milliseconds.
provenance.sourceTime: Preserve lexical date, kind, precision and optional evidenced zone/parsed instant; absence is not fabricated history.
provenance.evidenceVocabulary: Exact source types are pinned; string-valued classifications are not represented as closed enums or authenticated assertions.

body.spans: Ordered, non-overlapping code-point spans, end exclusive; exact body text.
body.profileValues: Strings, booleans, null, safe integers or recursive field objects; arrays and unsupported values rejected.
body.qualification: Codec/profile descriptor shapes are pinned. Fixture specDigest/schema labels are synthetic, not a qualified CommonMark specification or host profile.

capacity.limitRule: Every bound requires a positive safe-integer limit and a unit allowed for that field; missing/invalid bounds reject with invalid-capacity.
capacity.enforcement: checkRevisionBodyCapacity checks body/segment UTF-8 bytes and profile canonical bytes; validateRevisionBody accepts capacity as an optional argument.
capacity.operationalValuesStatus: due; no measured/deployment limits or defaults are supplied by these source artifacts
capacity.qualificationGate: SPEC section 4.6 says missing values block contract freeze. The fix review accepts the schema but defers operational qualification to production; this receipt does not silently waive the earlier SPEC gate.

commands.decisionBinding: Exact existing revision hash, or creation aggregate version plus proposed-content digest; no future output-hash circularity.
commands.boundaries: Root contract and transaction handle remain driver-agnostic; no Drizzle/pg type or runtime is introduced by this manifest.

reviewAndLifecycle.semantics: Review binds exact revision hashes; resolved contests need renewed validation. Archive is reversible; tombstone cannot be undone; purge requires intent/outcome. Current source applicability and authority remain host-qualified.

vectorCorpus.contents: Eleven kind-specific inputs/envelopes, canonical UTF-8 JSON strings and expected SHA-256 values; six standalone canonical vectors, eight geometry vectors and twelve declared rejection cases.
vectorCorpus.independence: The M1 build report and initial Gemini review report independent recomputation of all 17 expected digests. That historical claim is attributed to those sources; this authoring pass computed file checksums only.

steps: Any shared signature, wire rule, schema/hash/codec/profile rule, dependency boundary or undeclared export change gets a new contract manifest/version, even before real hashes exist.
Record author treatment and identified confirmation review on the changed bytes; rerun affected evidence.
Supply the new exact manifest/receipt and obtain acknowledged host realignment before dependent work uses it.
After real hashes exist, supply versioned linked conversion and receiver requalification; never rewrite existing chains or silently replace a baseline.

Additive M2/M3 implementation/wiring that exactly matches already frozen declarations records conformance and availability against the same manifest. An undeclared module signature or changed public placement is not automatically exempt.
